meta.source_title: Grouser wheel high-speed traction performance: DEM simulation and experimental result (Takehana et al.; Journal of Terramechanics 120, 2025, 101084)
meta.vehicle: single wheel testbed (high speed rig, sandpit 6.85 m by 0.5 m by 0.4 m, sand height 0.3 m)
meta.soil: Tohoku Silica Sand No. 5 (washed natural quartz sand, rounded grains)
meta.friction_angle_deg: not reported (angle of repose 34 deg, Sec 5.2)
meta.preparation: tilled with a shovel, levelled with a board, checked with a level; vane shear test for consistency
meta.y_name: traction coefficient (drawbar pull over vertical load)
meta.comparability_note: Markers found automatically as connected components of the blue (0.2 m/s) markers after a morphological opening that removes the thin fitted curve and error bars; legend excluded. Forced slip on level sand at wheel speed 0.2 m/s, the slowest speed tested but still faster than most planetary rovers; the paper shows strong speed dependence. Traction coefficient Fx/Fz is the tangent of an equivalent slope. Means of steady state data, error bars 1 SD not transcribed. Wheels are 3D printed PLA. Markers of other speeds drawn on top can hide part of a blue marker (fragments are merged, merge_px) or all of it (then that slip value is missing).
